description: Filter the tracked universe by trend direction, category and market-cap band, and sort the result. For movers questions ("what's pumping", "top gainers/losers today", "biggest movers") use sort_by="change24h" ("change7d" for the week) — sort_order="desc" for gainers, "asc" for losers — and quote each row's change from the row itself (`change_24h_pct` / `change_7d_pct`, or `change24h` / `change7d`). With the default marketCap sort rows are plain coin names; a change sort may return `{ rows: [...] }` with a coverage summary instead of a bare list. Pass ONE category per call; the server ignores case and punctuation ("meme", "Layer 2" and "DeFi" all work) and rejects an unknown name with close matches (list_categories has the names). There is no exchange filter yet: `exchange` is rejected with an explanation, because the only venue data behind this scan is spot listings. Do not present a scan as "coins on <exchange>". An empty result means no coin matched all the filters.

category.description: ONE category, e.g. "Meme", "Layer 2" or "DeFi"; case and punctuation are ignored (list_categories has the names). Comma-joined values are rejected; call once per category.

exchange.description: Not supported yet: the server rejects it with an explanation (its venue data covers spot listings only, so a filtered answer would mislead). Leave unset.

fields.description: Token-saving: comma-separated top-level fields to keep.

sort_by.description: Sort key (default marketCap). change24h / change7d = 24h / 7d price change, for movers / "what's pumping" questions.

sort_order.description: desc (default) = largest first; asc = smallest first (e.g. biggest 24h losers).

top.description: Keep only the first N items (default 50). Raise for more, lower to save tokens.

name: scan_coins

meta.description: Envelope metadata. Carries `_truncated` when a list was abridged to fit the response budget.
